current_state.zh: Igloo Inc. is winding down its Abstract chain and pivoting entirely to Pudgy Penguins, Pudgy NFTs and PENGU, with a new address moving $1M off Kraken to snap up 25 Pudgy Penguin NFTs shortly after the announcement.
